name: meow-ghostel-repaint-zsh
comment: A meow selection on the input row survives the shell repainting that row. zsh redraws its prompt every second (TMOUT + TRAPALRM running zle reset-prompt); ghostel deactivates a region whose rows a redraw rewrote, which would turn the following s (kill) into its no-selection fallback (C-k, kill to the end of input). The shell's output is the oracle: only the selected word is gone.

steps.comment: short prompt, redrawn every second; count the redraws that rewrite an active region

steps.eval: (progn (defvar meow-ghostel-elate--repaints 0) (advice-add 'ghostel--deactivate-repainted-region :before (lambda () (when (and (region-active-p) ghostel--repainted-region (< (region-beginning) (cdr ghostel--repainted-region)) (> (region-end) (car ghostel--repainted-region))) (setq meow-ghostel-elate--repaints (1+ meow-ghostel-elate--repaints))))))

steps.type: PROMPT='> '; RPROMPT=''; TMOUT=1; TRAPALRM() { zle reset-prompt }

steps.comment: select m40X backward, let the prompt repaint under the selection, then kill it
